hooks.command: g="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine/tools/guard"; if [ -x "$g" ]; then /bin/bash "$g"; c=$?; [ "$c" -eq 0 ] || exit 2; elif [ -e "$g" ]; then echo "engine guard: engine/tools/guard isn't executable; refusing the call (fails closed, R-79)" >&2; exit 2; elif [ -e "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine" ]; then echo "engine guard: engine/tools/guard is missing; refusing the call (fails closed, R-79)" >&2; exit 2; else exit 0; fi

s="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine/tools/session-start"; if [ -x "$s" ]; then /bin/bash "$s"; elif [ "${TALLY_ROLE:-}" = build ]; then echo "engine: engine/tools/session-start is missing; read engine/CLAUDE.md first (D6-2)"; fi

g="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine/tools/guard"; if [ -x "$g" ]; then /bin/bash "$g" --config-change; c=$?; [ "$c" -eq 0 ] || exit 2; elif [ -e "$g" ]; then echo "engine guard: engine/tools/guard isn't executable; refusing the call (fails closed, R-79)" >&2; exit 2; elif [ -e "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine" ]; then echo "engine guard: engine/tools/guard is missing; refusing the call (fails closed, R-79)" >&2; exit 2; else exit 0; fi

s="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine/tools/stop-check"; if [ -x "$s" ]; then /bin/bash "$s"; c=$?; [ "$c" -eq 0 ] || exit 2; elif [ -e "$s" ]; then echo "engine stop hook: engine/tools/stop-check isn't executable; the turn can't end (fails closed, R-83)" >&2; exit 2; elif [ -e "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/engine" ]; then echo "engine stop hook: engine/tools/stop-check is missing; the turn can't end (fails closed, R-83)" >&2; exit 2; else exit 0; fi
